label: early copy-phase steps (outputting original tokens 1-3) in long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during the original tokens or on <DEL>), concentrated on the first few copy steps after <DEL> (recall_idx 1-3, 94% of mass) and strongly gated by sequence length: essentially silent for L<=5, weak at L=6-7, and L=9 holds 70% of the mass (L=8 another 24%). A small secondary bump sits on the last copy steps of L=9 sequences (recall_idx 8). Within the window, which token is being fed back matters a lot (v, m, y, e, k, h, u give higher rates; i, r, a, o, d, f give lower ones), but no clean token set improves F1, so precision stays near 0.5: about half of the early-copy steps in long sequences are inactive. Magnitudes are small (max 0.016), and the largest activations land on recall_idx 1-2 of L=9 sequences. It does not fire on first occurrences of a token, on original-phase inputs, or on the delimiter.
